generations.action: soccer ball spinning in place around its vertical axis, black pentagon panels travelling smoothly around the sphere, one full revolution over the animation, ball stays perfectly centered with identical size every frame, no bouncing, no squashing, camera fixed

manual_cleanup: integer recentring of each frame to the master centroid (raw frames wandered +-1 px)
master silhouette alpha mask enforced on every frame (silhouette bit-identical across phases; killed two edge artifacts on frames 7-8)
interior holes filled from nearest opaque neighbour
palette quantized to the target set; final frames use 5 colours: #FFFFFF #F1F2EF #D1D4D1 #A7ACA9 #252929 (deepest #101313 unused after quantization)

micro_lod.measurement: projected visual diameter = 2*0.13m*18.083px/m*zoom: ~4.7px at 1x, ~9.4px at 2x (old draw law floored to 6px / 12px) — 1x collapse was representation, not artwork
micro_lod.authoring: PixelLab probes established the negative space (no eye, no ring); micro sprites then deterministically authored per the sanctioned fallback: white circular cluster + one dominant dark panel + one edge accent + shading crescent, palette = master palette subset
micro_lod.sizes: 7/8/9/10/11 px native, 4 rotation phases each (2/4/8-phase motion study: 2 flickers, 8 adds nothing at this resolution)
micro_lod.lod_rule: projected-diameter based: <12px -> micro drawn 1:1 at nearest authored size (7..11); >=12px -> accepted 24x24 detailed 8-phase sprite; same continuous theta drives both (micro = floor(theta/2pi*4))
micro_lod.shadow: variant B adopted: alpha 0.32 -> 0.22, footprint and (x,y,0) position unchanged
